title: aero-research-platform
description:
An open-source, CFD-in-the-loop aerodynamic shape optimizer whose outputs are gated by provenance and uncertainty. Every reported number carries a four-fold provenance tuple and a combined U95 envelope (GCI / ASME V&V 20 numerical, batch-means statistical, and input terms). A claimed improvement must exceed 2×U95 at matched numerics, every optimum is re-verified by CFD, and every exported result is a self-describing result crate (RO-Crate 1.3 / PROV) that verifies away from the compute cluster.

The optimizer has never been run on a flapping-wing case, and v0.1.0 makes no flapping-wing optimization claim. It is demonstrated on a 2-D airfoil (validated tier, gate-honest). The flagship flapping domain ships as a forward capability, whose gated mean lift is a documented NO-GO. The release notes list every gate outcome and every result-crate digest.
notes: Built with substantial assistance from AI coding agents (Claude Code, Anthropic), under the direction of the author; see the AI usage disclosure in paper/paper.md. Cite a specific result by its result-crate digest plus its four-tuple (crates/README.md).
